Rafael: quick thinkpiece 0min: want to formalize the onboarding contract surface so SMOKE/COMPAT/VALIDATION lanes can be independently optimized. bringing up tradeoffs and a proposed minimal schema.
Maya: ok, what's the contract surface?
Rafael: at intake we capture a small immutable fingerprint + capability flags. fingerprint drives deterministic checks; flags opt-into heavy evals. propose fields: model_id, arch, tokenizer_hash, quant_kind, supports_kv_cache, max_seq_len, export_tool, expected_kv_layout.
Ibrahim: can you give an example?
Rafael: sure: ```
model_id: rdx-mix-3b
arch: mix-3b
tokenizer_hash: sha256:bf12...
quant_kind: q4_0
supports_kv_cache: true
max_seq_len: 2048
export_tool: torchscript-2026-03
expected_kv_layout: [n_heads, head_dim, shard_layout]
```
Tess: having expected_kv_layout in intake is gold. COMPAT can compare binary KV layout to that and fail fast if mismatch.
Maya: tradeoffs? this makes intake slightly heavier and requires exporters to surface extra metadata.
Rafael: true. cost: +1 small metadata write and verification. benefit: avoids subtle runtime mismatches that ripple into production. We can make some fields optional but mark fingerprint mandatory.
Ibrahim: runtime checks: SMOKE asserts model load + tokenizer roundtrip + KV shape match + no fallback kernels. COMPAT runs deterministic replay on the KV mapping and memory-growth profile across a 60s RTT loop. VALIDATION runs stat-driven evals and shadow replay.
Maya: how to pick thresholds? we need numeric SLOs otherwise teams will tune to pass.
Rafael: propose defaults: SMOKE: load_success=100% within 30s, tokenizer_roundtrip_errors=0, p95_infer(ci-tiny)<=120ms. COMPAT: memory_growth<=8% over baseline, kernel_fallback_count=0, tokenization_mismatch_rate<=0.1%. VALIDATION: quality_drift<=deltaX on top intents, to be product-defined.
Tess: and rollback hooks? if VALIDATION later detects regression, we should auto-suspend new model and revert traffic to prior candidate.
Ibrahim: agree. tie shadow monitor to rollout controller: if cumulative drift > X for 30m, trigger rollback. product defines X but default X=5% relative degradation.
Maya: cost controls? running VALIDATION often is expensive.
Rafael: heuristic: full VALIDATION on arch change, quant_kind change, or if COMPAT reports non-determinism. Otherwise run a delta-validation (100 stratified prompts) that compares embeddings+answer-similarity to baseline. Pass -> proceed, fail -> enqueue full VALIDATION.
infra-bot: quota note: estimated incremental GPU-hours if full VALIDATION runs for every candidate: ~18 GPU-hours/model. Delta-validation estimate: ~0.6 GPU-hours/model.
Tess: good to capture that estimate in intake UI so submitters know expected delay/cost.
onboard-bot: created ticket ONB-9612 "contract-schema + lane thresholds" (assignee: Rafael).
Maya: action items: Rafael+Tess formalize schema + required vs optional fields; Ibrahim draft numeric thresholds and sim plan; Maya will add intake UI hinting for expected cost and lane.
Rafael: I'll sketch a tiny JSON schema for intake and open a PR. closing this thread once PR link is up.
